title: sabulina howellii
intro: Sabulina howellii, commonly known as Howell's sedge, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant is said to have therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. Bioactive constituents of Sabulina howellii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, although further research is needed to confirm its effects on human health.
